nonrecurrent_comparator: highest mean validation accuracy over seeds101,202,303; ties prefer measured lower CPU p95 latency, then fewer parameters
recurrent_selection: mean validation accuracy at least0.03 above strongest predeclared nonrecurrent comparator; mean macroF1 no lower than that comparator

deployment_targets.workload: one at-most5second clip, CPU2threads, warmed WAV-to-logits

selection_fallback: best eligible nonrecurrent comparator; still retain and report the trained CNN+GRU hybrid
notes: Operational thresholds for this offline prototype; not universal significance or real-world robustness guarantees. Tokenwise versus pooled heads also differ in dropout granularity.
